title: WR-90 whose broad wall waves, a = 22.86 + 2 sin(2πz/10) mm for four periods between 10 mm leads, a SolidCraft design with the wave an equation curve: S21 at 10 GHz
source: The smooth wall itself, solved as the two-dimensional problem it is (emcraft_theory::wall::SmoothGuide): between the side walls the TE10 harmonic's field E_y obeys the Helmholtz equation in the plane of the waving wall, E_y = 0 on it; the guide mapped onto a rectangle (η = x/a(z)) with the wall exact at every quadrature point, spectral elements of degree 8 (480 along, 6 across), the ends closed by their modal conditions (24 modes) — 0.001° from 240 × 4 elements: ∠S21 −172.366°, |S11| 0.0082. Mode matching of the wall cut into steps agrees here, the field being zero on the wall (−172.27° at 640 steps, within 0.1° of the smooth wall from 1280; a heavy test keeps the two together)
